title: Marathon world record: seconds shaved off per year

source.name: Super shoes and marathon record progression
source.publisher: Marathon Handbook / World Athletics record data

notes: Between 1988 and 2013 (pre carbon-plate 'super shoes'), the men's world record fell from 2:06:50 to 2:03:23 -- 207 seconds over 25 years, about 8.3 seconds/year. Since super shoes arrived in 2016, the record has fallen another 207 seconds (3:27) through Kiptum's 2023 run, about 29.6 seconds/year -- roughly 3.6x faster. Figures approximate as publicly reported.
